Alex — thanks, and great to hear Stellarium is ready to proceed. I attached a working MAP (Stellarium_MAP_v1.2.xlsx) that breaks the first 12 weeks into sprint lanes and ownership. Highlights below:

- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): access, accounts, and SFTP test -> Owner: Stellarium infra + onboarding@stellarium.com
- Week 1: Ingest sample data, schema validation, and initial model routing -> Owner: Ben Carter (Implementation Lead)
- Week 2–3: Integration tests and latency tuning; we reserve a weekend cutover window for schema switchover -> Owner: Ben + Engineering
- Week 4–6: Monitoring, thresholding, and evaluation suites (quality regression checks) -> Owner: Marissa Cole (CSM)
- Week 7–12: Optimization sprint (batching, caching config), production rollback/contingency drills -> Owners: Ben + Sofia (Platform)

Failure-mode mitigations included in the sheet: KV-cache priming, staged traffic ramp (10/30/60/100%), and a documented rollback that restores traffic to existing endpoints within 15 minutes.

Proposed kickoff slot: Tue, Jul 7, 10:00–11:00 PT. If that conflicts with your infra team's OOO, we can move to Wed. Please confirm and share any firm constraints.

Sofia Ivanova
